D: An FBI agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfing bank robbers.
P: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny Utah orders two.
S: Beer battered white fish in flour tortillas with slaw and chipotle mayo

Crispy beer-battered fish in small soft tortillas with lime slaw, chipotle mayo and fresh coriander, with extra lime wedges to squeeze. Cut 500g firm white fish into strips. Whisk 120g plain flour with 180ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Dip the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Warm 12 small flour tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.
King prawns with garlic, chili and lime, grilled on skewers
King prawns skewered with garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals 90 seconds a side.
M: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on long rolls with melted provolone
Pork and beef meatballs simmered an hour in marinara, packed into long rolls with provolone, grilled until melted. Two each.
Bonfire whole snapper with chilli lime
Bodhi's crew around the beach bonfire

Whole snapper slashed and rubbed with garlic, chilli, lime and coriander, grilled over hot coals until charred, with coconut rice and a green mango salad. Blend 3 garlic cloves, 2 red chillies, a bunch of coriander stems, the zest and juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 2 tbsp oil. Slash 2 whole snapper (800g each) and rub the paste inside and out. Grill over medium-hot coals 8 to 10 minutes a side. Simmer 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Toss shredded green mango, mint, peanuts and lime juice for salad.
W: Banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, fudge, nuts and a cherry
Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Tequila, lime and orange liqueur shaken and served on the rocks with a salt rim

Tequila shaken with fresh lime, orange liqueur and agave, poured over ice in salt-rimmed glasses with a lime wheel. Rub the rims of 4 tumblers with lime and dip in flaky salt, then fill with ice. Shake 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur and 30ml agave syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain over the ice and garnish each with a lime wheel. Mix a jug ahead for the esky if you're out on the sand.

steps.text: Soak the skewers. Toss the prawns with crushed garlic, chopped chilli, lime zest and juice, and oil.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals on both sides.
Serve with lime wedges.
Cut the fish into strips. Whisk the flour, beer and salt into a batter.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.
Mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and salt and roll into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in oil.
Simmer in the passata with crushed garlic.
Pack into the rolls, top with provolone and grill until melted.
Split the bananas lengthways into dishes and add a scoop of each ice cream.
Melt the chocolate with some of the cream for the fudge.
Whip the rest of the cream and slice the strawberries.
Top with fudge, strawberries, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.

s.note: King prawns with garlic, chili and lime, grilled on skewers
s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the zest and juice of a lime and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill over hot coals for 90 seconds a side. Serve with lime wedges.

s.note: Beer battered white fish in flour tortillas with slaw and chipotle mayo
s.how: Cut 500g firm white fish into strips. Whisk 120g plain flour with 180ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Dip the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Warm 12 small flour tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.

m.note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on long rolls with melted provolone
m.how: Mix 400g beef mince and 400g pork mince with 1 egg, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan and salt, and roll into 24 meatballs. Brown, then simmer in 700ml passata with 2 garlic cloves for 1 hour. Pack into 8 long rolls, top with 8 slices provolone and grill until melted. Two each.

w.note: Banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, fudge, nuts and a cherry
w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into four dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for fudge. Top with fudge, sliced strawberries, whipped cream, chopped nuts and a cherry.

d.note: Tequila, lime and orange liqueur shaken and served on the rocks with a salt rim
d.how: Rub the rims of 4 tumblers with lime and dip in flaky salt, then fill with ice. Shake 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur and 30ml agave syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain over the ice and garnish each with a lime wheel. Mix a jug ahead for the esky if you're out on the sand.
